subject: Request: Confirm invoice author, delivery mode, and VAT evidence conduit
messages:
From: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@nebulahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: nebula-ap@nebulahealth.com
Date: 2027-09-15T16:12:00Z
Subject: Who will send the invoice for DL-2027-0831?

Hi Jordan —

Quick question on the upcoming first invoice for our pilot (DL-2027-0831): does Redwood want us to accept invoices authored and pushed from your systems, or do you prefer to have Nebula Health create the invoice and push to our AP? Our AP team needs to know who is the invoice originator so they can map remit lines and VAT metadata.

We also need to confirm where we should expect VAT evidence (certificate) and whether you can include a VAT tag in the invoice XML. If you can push via API/portal, that would be preferred — but we can accept signed PDFs by email as a fallback during onboarding.

Thanks —
Claire Hughes
AP Operations | Nebula Health
[attachment: nebula-vat-certificate.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@nebulahealth.com>, nebula-ap@nebulahealth.com
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T18:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Who will send the invoice for DL-2027-0831?

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the note. To reduce reconciliation friction we propose Redwood act as the invoice originator for the pilot and push the invoice to Nebula via our portal/webhook. Benefits: consistent invoice metadata, VAT tag included in the XML, and automatic PO/line matching where possible.

Operational asks for Nebula AP:
- Can you confirm the exact PO/GL code format you need in the XML (example: PO-12345 or 12345)?
- Will you accept a single invoice per month per entity for the pilot?
- Confirm who should receive a PDF copy by email (if anyone).

Fallback: if portal enrollment isn't completed before the first billing date we can send a signed PDF by email and attach the XML sample in a follow-up. Attached is a sample invoice XML that includes a VAT element (sample-invoice.xml).

Connor/Marissa — looping you in to confirm Redwood-side authoring and whether legal needs to sign off on the invoice origin wording in the contract (we want to avoid misattribution).

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: sample-invoice.xml (XML)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@nebulahealth.com>, nebula-ap@nebulahealth.com
Date: 2027-09-16T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Re: Who will send the invoice for DL-2027-0831?

Jordan —

Agree that Redwood-originated invoices will be cleaner for long-term ops. A couple of notes on the implementation side:
- We'll need the PO format (Claire) to populate <orderReference> and <buyerReference> fields in the XML.
- We should include a VAT identification field and an explicit "VAT evidence provided" flag so AP can automatedly reconcile.
- For the pilot, we'll enable an "email copy" checkbox so Nebula gets a PDF to nebula-ap@nebulahealth.com while principal delivery is via the portal push.

Marissa: can you confirm whether Finance needs the invoice to carry the phrasing "Invoice issued by Redwood Inference on behalf of Redwood Services, Inc." or whether it should be simply "Redwood Inference"? Legal asked about potential passthrough language. If legal requires a special phrase we may need to update the SOW.

Connor O'Brien
Billing Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@nebulahealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-16T21:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Re: Re: Who will send the invoice for DL-2027-0831?

Claire / team —

Confirming Redwood will be the invoice originator for the pilot and we'll push via portal/webhook. Action items and timeline: 
- Claire: confirm PO format by EOD Friday (we'll map to <orderReference>).
- Nebula AP: temporary acceptance of signed PDF by email for first month if portal enrollment is delayed. Please confirm that nebula-ap@nebulahealth.com can receive PDFs and that the mailbox is monitored for invoice acknowledgements.
- Jordan/Connor: I'll update the invoice template to include a VAT evidence flag and a link to the uploaded VAT certificate if present. We'll attach the XML payload and a signed PDF to the first invoice delivery for traceability (attachments: sample-invoice.xml, signed-invoice-temp.pdf).

We will not change contract language for this — "Redwood Inference" on the invoice is sufficient per Finance. If Nebula requires wording beyond that we can escalate.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
[attachment: signed-invoice-temp.pdf (PDF)]
